transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because for the past week, I've been feeling completely emotionally numb. My mind just feels empty, and I can't seem to feel any happiness or joy even when good things happen.
Did these feelings start after a traumatic event or a major life stressor happened to you? If so, what happened?

To be honest, I'm not really sure what specific event could have triggered this, and I can't think of any particular stressor. All I know is that these feelings have been going on for about a week now.
Before this past week, have you been feeling down or emotionally numb most days for at least two years, even if it was milder than now?
No, I haven't felt this way at all before this past week. This is a very sudden and recent change for me, as I felt completely normal before.
Over this past week, have you also had symptoms like trouble sleeping, low energy, poor concentration, appetite changes, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death or suicide?

No, I haven't really experienced those symptoms like trouble sleeping, appetite changes, or thoughts of self-harm. My main struggles right now are just this deep emotional numbness and the fact that I've been getting extremely easily startled by things.
Have you recently experienced or witnessed something terrifying or life-threatening, and since then have you been having unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks about it?
No, I haven't experienced any terrifying or life-threatening events, and I'm not having any nightmares or flashbacks. I've just been feeling completely emotionally numb and extremely jumpy lately.
For the past several months, have you been feeling excessive worry or anxiety about many different parts of your life that is hard to control?

No, I haven't really been experiencing excessive or uncontrollable worry about different areas of my life. These struggles with feeling numb and easily startled have only been going on for about a week now.
Even if it wasn’t traumatic, did anything stressful or upsetting happen in the past few weeks, like a conflict, loss, breakup, work problem, or major change?

Honestly, nothing major or specific like that comes to mind, and I'm really not sure what could have started this. I've just been dealing with this empty, numb feeling and being incredibly easily startled for the past week.
Has this numbness and jumpiness been interfering with your work, school, relationships, or daily activities over the past week?

Yes, it has definitely been impacting my relationships because I feel completely numb to love and affection towards my family and partner. On top of that, the constant jumpiness and how long it takes me to calm down make daily activities exhausting and very hard to manage.
During this past week, have you felt detached from yourself or your surroundings, like things aren’t real or you’re watching yourself from outside your body?
No, I haven't really felt detached from myself or like things aren't real. It's more that my mind just feels completely empty and numb, rather than feeling like I'm watching myself from the outside.
Along with feeling numb, have you actually been feeling sad or depressed most of the day, nearly every day this past week?
No, I haven't really been feeling sad or depressed. Instead, my mind just feels completely empty and numb, as if all of my emotions are blocked. This is how it has been for the past week.
